name: Ayesha & Omar Farooq
quote: They designed our home around how we actually live — down to the drawer that hides the school bags. Handover day felt like moving into a magazine.

name: Daniyal Haq
quote: The café paid for its fit-out in eleven months. Customers come in for the room and stay for the coffee. That was the brief, and Woodex delivered it.

name: Sadia Kamran
quote: Two floors, ninety workstations, zero drama. The schedule they published on day one is the schedule we got. Our people genuinely love coming in now.

name: Richard & Elena Marsh
quote: We managed everything from Dubai over video calls. The 3D walkthroughs were so accurate that the finished bedroom matched them nail for nail.

name: Hasan Ali
quote: They turned a shell into a store in seven weeks. The custom oak displays are the first thing customers touch — and photograph.

name: Dr. Faisal Qureshi
quote: The joinery is furniture-grade. Clients ask about the shelving more than the treatment. Ten-year warranty was the deciding factor, and the craft is obvious.
